title: Quality + value, top 20, monthly
note: Contract 0.4: a factor-ranked strategy has no rule tree. Every month, rank the universe by the equal-weighted quality and value scores with size and industry removed, and hold the top 20 at no more than 8% each. Factor codes come from the runtime's factor listing (alphaspec factors); global: picks the platform-wide factor when you also have a factor of the same code.
